```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

data = read.csv("Best_RL_results.csv")
data2 = read.csv("Heur_Only_results.csv")
data3 = read.csv("Random_Baseline_results.csv")
data4 =  read.csv("Best_RL_Improve_RL_results.csv")
colnames(data)
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

sam_noise = 0.1
move_noise = 0.1

df = rbind(data, data2, data4) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(normalized_cumulative_reward, best_reward,
                        mean_normalized_cumulative_reward, mean_best_reward))

df_random_5 = data3 %>% filter(n_agents==5) %>%
  summarise(
    normalized_cumulative_reward      = mean(normalized_cumulative_reward,      na.rm = TRUE),
    best_reward                       = mean(best_reward,                       na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_normalized_cumulative_reward = mean(mean_normalized_cumulative_reward, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_best_reward                  = mean(mean_best_reward,                  na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "name", values_to = "value")
  
df_random_10 = data3 %>% filter(n_agents==10) %>%
  summarise(
    normalized_cumulative_reward      = mean(normalized_cumulative_reward,      na.rm = TRUE),
    best_reward                       = mean(best_reward,                       na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_normalized_cumulative_reward = mean(mean_normalized_cumulative_reward, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_best_reward                  = mean(mean_best_reward,                  na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "name", values_to = "value")


facet_levels   = c("normalized_cumulative_reward", "best_reward",
                  "mean_normalized_cumulative_reward", "mean_best_reward")
df$name        = factor(df$name,        levels = facet_levels)
df_random_5$name = factor(df_random_5$name, levels = facet_levels)
df_random_10$name = factor(df_random_10$name, levels = facet_levels)

ggplot(df %>% filter(n_agents == 5, movement_noise == move_noise, sample_noise == sam_noise),
       aes(y = value, x = as.factor(comm_radius), fill = model)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(vars(name)) +
  geom_hline(data = df_random_5, aes(yintercept = value), color = "black", linetype = "dashed")

ggplot(df %>% filter(n_agents == 10, movement_noise == move_noise, sample_noise == sam_noise),
       aes(y = value, x = as.factor(comm_radius), fill = model)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(vars(name)) +
  geom_hline(data = df_random_10, aes(yintercept = value), color = "black", linetype = "dashed")


dfmean = rbind(data, data2, data4) %>% 
  group_by(n_agents, comm_radius, movement_noise, sample_noise, model) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_normalized_cumulative_reward = mean(mean_normalized_cumulative_reward, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_best_reward                  = mean(mean_best_reward,                  na.rm = TRUE),
    normalized_cumulative_reward      = mean(normalized_cumulative_reward,      na.rm = TRUE),
    best_reward                       = mean(best_reward,                       na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(normalized_cumulative_reward, best_reward,
                        mean_normalized_cumulative_reward, mean_best_reward))

dfmean$name = factor(dfmean$name, levels = facet_levels)

ggplot(dfmean %>% filter(sample_noise == sam_noise, movement_noise == move_noise, n_agents == 5),
       aes(x = comm_radius, y = value, color = model)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(name)) +
  geom_hline(data = df_random_5, aes(yintercept = value), color = "black", linetype = "dashed")

ggplot(dfmean %>% filter(sample_noise == sam_noise, movement_noise == move_noise, n_agents == 10),
       aes(x = comm_radius, y = value, color = model)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(name)) +
  geom_hline(data = df_random_10, aes(yintercept = value), color = "black", linetype = "dashed")

```
